statutory.question: Does the conduct described fall within 31 U.S.C. § 5324 — Structuring transactions to evade reporting requirements?
statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: The statute § 5324(a)(3) prohibits structuring transactions to evade reporting requirements. The factual record shows 27 transactions of varying amounts, many under $10,000, that collectively approach the declared monthly volume of $302,900, indicating an effort to break down the total into smaller transfers. This pattern satisfies each element of the statutory provision, as the conduct involves structuring cash and near‑cash receipts to avoid triggering reporting thresholds, precisely what § 5324(a)(3) prohibits structuring.
